Court of Common Pleas for the County of Cumberland,
Yorkland, Berwick and Baldton at Portland, in Maine.

On the first Thursday of December, 1800.
On the Petition of John Morrill, and
others, WHICH was entered At the last term Of this Court
and continued to this term whereof the foregoing
is the Court order, That the Petitioners can not
obtain the tract of land therein mentioned.

Notice of said Petition by publick notice
of the same thereof is this order thereof to the said
rates Gazette, printed at Portland, three weeks
notice, the said publication to be at least one
before the third Tuesday Of October next, that
they may have opportunity TO appear at the Court of
Common Pleas, then to be holden At Portland within
the County aforesaid, and show cause why the prayer Of said petition should not
be granted.

Samuel Freeman, CLERK.
